title: 第3章 灾星死遁第4章 灭魔英雄
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
“……什么？”
所有天剑宗弟子集体宕机了零点五秒。
在他们的印象里，宁楚还是那个会因为别人多看她一眼就追着人家揍三条街的骄纵大小姐。
是那个整天被天雷追着跑的灾星，是偷了宁宝儿宗主千金之位的小偷。
她怎么会……
一道绚烂的光芒在宁楚周身炸开。
“宁楚！！！”宁宝儿第一个反应过来，尖叫着冲了上去。
她不知道宁楚要做什么，但那个架势怎么看怎么像要自爆。
真千金眼眶通红，一边飞一边骂：“你是不是有病！你回来！谁让你逞英雄了！”
宁雄霸紧随其后，脸色煞白，他认出了那道秘术，献祭生命和全部修为，以身为引，修补封印。
这是上古秘术，施展之后魂飞魄散。
“楚儿，住手！”宁雄霸的声音都在抖，“爹命令你住手！”
宁楚不是不想回头，只是她现在整个人都在被封印之力拉扯，根本动不了。
疼得要命。
但她还是挤出最后一口气，扭头冲宁宝儿笑了笑，嘴唇翕动。
宁宝儿读出了她的唇语。
“我不欠你了。”
“混蛋混蛋！”宁宝儿一剑砍翻两个挡路的魔兵，“你欠我的，你永远欠我的！别想用死来逃避！”
宁楚的身体开始消散，从指尖开始，像碎掉的萤火虫，一点一点化作光点，融入封印裂缝中。
裂缝在以肉眼可见的速度合拢，魔兵被碾碎的声音此起彼伏。

宁宝儿无法靠近，只能疯了一样地输送灵力，想把宁楚拉回来。
宁雄霸也冲了上去，把毕生修为不要钱似的往宁楚身体里灌。
更多的天剑宗弟子涌了上来。
他们排成一条长龙，前面的人把手搭在宗主肩上，后面的人搭在前面的人肩上，灵力汇聚成一条金色的河流，逆着封印的吸力，往宁楚身上送。
那些曾经嫌弃过宁楚的弟子，那些在背后叫她灾星的同门，此刻全都红着眼睛，把灵力往封印里送。
没有人退缩。
合欢宗宗主怔愣一瞬，旋即在身边大弟子头上拍了一把，“看什么看，那算我半个徒弟，还不帮忙！”
言毕，她转身向其他宗门的人斩钉截铁地说：“封魔崖封印若破，整个浮生界将毁于一旦。输灵力，帮宁楚一把！”
合欢宗弟子二话不说，加入了输送灵力的队伍。
然后是天机阁、药王谷、太虚宗……
越来越多的修士把手搭了上去，灵力的河流越来越宽，越来越亮，像一条金色的巨龙，盘旋在封魔崖上空。
金光越来越盛，宁楚整个人已经快变成透明的了，灵力像漏了底的米袋，哗哗地往外流，但封印还差最后一角，怎么都补不上。
就差一点，最后一点点。
但她的灵力已经空了，封印裂缝还在往外渗黑气，像嘲笑他们似的慢悠悠地往外冒。
宁楚深吸一口气，气到一半想起来自己现在是个半透明人，连肺都没有，吸了个寂寞。
就在她觉得自己真要交代在这儿而不是死遁的时候，她忽然感觉到头顶有什么东西在盯着她。
不是魔兵。
是天道。
那团跟了她一百八十八年的乌云，此刻正蹲在封魔崖上空，虎视眈眈地盯着她。
宁楚脑子里灵光一闪。

天道法则。
content_en:
"...What?"
All Tianjian Sect disciples collectively went down for 0.5 seconds.
In their impression, Ning Chu was still the arrogant young lady who would chase people and beat them up three streets just because they looked at her too much.
He was the disaster star who was chased by thunder all day long, and he was the thief who stole Ning Baoer's position as the daughter of the sect leader.
How could she...
A brilliant ray of light exploded around Ning Chu.
"Ning Chu!!!" Ning Baoer was the first to react, screaming and rushing forward.
She didn't know what Ning Chu was going to do, but that posture looked like he was going to self-destruct.
The real daughter's eyes were red, and she scolded as she flew: "Are you sick? Come back! Who asked you to act like a hero!"
Ning Xiongba followed closely, his face turned pale, he recognized the secret technique, sacrificed his life and all his cultivation, used his body to lead, and repaired the seal.
This is an ancient secret technique, and after being used, one's soul will fly away.
"Chu'er, stop!" Ning Xiongba's voice was trembling, "Father orders you to stop!"
It's not that Ning Chu doesn't want to look back, it's just that her whole body is being pulled by the power of the seal and she can't move at all.
It hurt like hell.
But she still squeezed out her last breath, turned around and smiled at Ning Baoer, her lips moving.
Ning Baoer read her lips.
"I don't owe you anymore."
"Bastard, bastard!" Ning Baoer chopped down two demon soldiers blocking the way with one sword, "You owe me, you will always owe me! Don't even think about escaping by dying!"
Ning Chu's body began to dissipate, starting from his fingertips, like broken fireflies, turning into points of light bit by bit, blending into the cracks of the seal.
The cracks were closing at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the sounds of demonic soldiers being crushed could be heard one after another.
Ning Baoer couldn't get close, so he could only channel his spiritual power like crazy, trying to pull Ning Chu back.
Ning Xiongba also rushed forward and poured his life's cultivation into Ning Chu's body as if it was free of charge.
More Tianjian Sect disciples rushed up.
They lined up in a long queue. The person in front put their hands on the shoulders of the sect leader, and the people behind put their hands on the shoulders of the person in front. The spiritual energy gathered into a golden river, and was sent to Ning Chu against the suction of the seal.
Those disciples who had disliked Ning Chu and those who called her Disaster Star behind her back all had red eyes at this moment and were sending their spiritual power into the seal.
No one backed down.
The leader of the Hehuan Sect was stunned for a moment, and then slapped the eldest disciple next to him on the head, "What are you looking at? That's my half-disciple, and you're still not helping me!"
After saying this, she turned to the other sects and said categorically: "If the seal of Demon Sealing Cliff is broken, the entire floating world will be destroyed. Lose your spiritual power and help Ning Chu!"
Without saying a word, the disciples of the Hehuan Sect joined the team transporting spiritual power.
Then there is Tianji Pavilion, Yaowang Valley, Taixu Sect...
More and more monks put their hands on it, and the river of spiritual power became wider and brighter, like a golden dragon, hovering over the Demon Sealing Cliff.
The golden light became stronger and stronger, and Ning Chu's whole body was almost transparent. His spiritual power was like a leaky rice bag, flowing out, but the seal was still missing the last corner and could not be repaired no matter what.
Just a little bit, just a little bit at the end.
But her spiritual power was already empty, and black air was still leaking out of the cracks in the seal, slowly leaking out as if laughing at them.
Ning Chu took a deep breath. Halfway through, he remembered that he was now a translucent person without even lungs, and took a lonely breath.
Just when she thought she really wanted to confess here instead of escaping, she suddenly felt something above her head staring at her.
Not a magic soldier.
It's the way of heaven.
The dark clouds that had followed her for one hundred and eighty-eight years were now squatting over the Demon Sealing Cliff, staring at her eagerly.
An idea flashed in Ning Chu's mind.
The laws of heaven.
